description: This Java class 'DefaultPolicyConfig' implements the 'PolicyConfig' interface, encapsulating configuration settings for policies such as supervisor configuration, activity check, and snapshot settings. It provides a static factory method to instantiate the class from a Typesafe Config object, applying specific configuration paths, and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.
